metadata.title: Pomona · Produce Picker
metadata.description: Instant bounding-box produce picker and ripeness guide.

verifier.unsupportedTie: Visible cues do not establish individual maturity. Please provide a clearer view.
verifier.similar: These look similarly mature. Please show a closer individual view.
verifier.missing: I cannot confidently choose from this view. Turn the produce to show the underside or stem.
verifier.unclear: The produce is obscured. Retake a clear photo with its surface visible.
verifier.noProduce: No produce found. Take a photo of the fruit or vegetables you want to compare.
verifier.multiple: Several produce types are visible. Draw around one type to compare it.
verifier.failed: Analysis could not finish. Please take another photo and try again.
verifier.finalBanner: 1st Pick ({{score}}) was only graded from the top. Flip the {{produce}} for a final check.
verifier.finalInstruction: Turn your 1st pick {{produce}} over to show its underside.

gate.noProduce: No fresh produce is visible. Please photograph the fruit or vegetables you want to compare.
gate.unclearPhoto: The produce is obscured. Please take a clearer photo showing its surfaces.
gate.multipleTypes: Several produce types share the view. Please draw around one type or take a closer photo.
gate.singleProduce: Only one produce item is visible. To evaluate a single piece, use Inspect up close to check all sides.
gate.rateLimited: Scan allowance or service capacity reached. Please try again later.
gate.failed: The photo check is unavailable. Please try again later.
gate.tooLarge: The capture package is too large. Please try again shortly.
